Maple Research cards

Branding·by @ayushsoni_io·2026-09-01·inspora page·original post

What it is

Pair of brand cards (black 'Maple Research' card, blue org card) whose faces carry a live halftone dot-field: grids of dots whose sizes swell/shrink to render slowly morphing organic blobs, like a fluid seen through a dot screen.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Two vertical cards; black card shows white dotted blob shapes mid-morph; blue card shows the same field in darker blue dots; text locked up top-left and bottom-left.
20-50%
The dotted blobs drift and merge - metaball-like unions and separations; dot radius encodes the field value (bigger dot = inside the shape).
50-80%
Blobs keep morphing with smooth noise-driven motion; no hard edges anywhere - everything resolves through dot size.
80-100%
Field continues cycling; text and card chrome never move; infinite ambient loop.

Mechanics

trigger
autoplay ambient
elements
2 cards, dot-grid canvas per card
properties
per-dot radius (field value), field = sum of 2-3 moving radial metaballs + noise
timing
morph cycle ~8-12s, continuous
easing
smooth noise (simplex) drift
loop
infinite

Build prompt

Build halftone metaball cards. Each card: solid fill (near-black / electric blue #1D4ED8-ish) with a canvas of dots on a fixed grid (~10-14px pitch). Per frame compute a scalar field at each grid point: sum of 2-3 radial metaballs whose centers drift on simplex-noise paths (slow, period 8-12s), plus a little high-frequency noise. Map field value to dot radius (0 below threshold, up to ~55% of pitch at field max) with a smoothstep knee so shapes read as soft blobs. Dot color: white on the black card, darker shade of the card color on the blue card. Lock typography top-left (wordmark + 2-line headline) and bottom-left (small descriptor + logo). Cap DPR at 2, batch arc() calls, ~60fps. Reduced motion: freeze one frame.
